messages:
Maya (AE): quick presales sync for OrbitCorp POC — they want 2 weeks. Need: success metrics, latency/cost targets, KMS/VPC, eval ownership.
Riley (SE): Proposed: 1 week ramp + 1 week acceptance. Targets: p50 <200ms (256 tokens), p95 <450ms, error_rate <0.5%. Quality: >=90% pass on their 150-prompt set. Cost target ~= $0.02/1k tokens avg.
Jordan (Customer): OK. We will do human labeling on 150 prompts. p95 can be up to 500ms for our UI. Pilot budget ~ $8k.
Lina (Security): Requirements: customer-managed KMS, audit logs, EU log residency (eu-west-1), SOC2 excerpt. Send security questionnaire and we'll complete.
Omar (Infra): For a short POC we can do hosted with envelope encryption + regional logs pinned. KMS binding ~72 hours after key ARN. VPC peering possible but longer.
Riley (SE): Eval plan: run 150 prompt suite + live-sampled traffic (10k tokens/day). A/B: 4-bit quantized vs baseline. Metrics: accuracy_pct, hallucination_rate, avg_tokens, p50/p95 latency, error_rate. Acceptance: accuracy >=90 AND hallucination <=3% AND error_rate <=0.5%.
Jordan (Customer): If quantization lowers quality >5% we won't accept it. We'll share infra contact for peering.
Riley (SE): Quick perf curl for their runs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Maya (AE): Actions: Riley = eval harness + repo; Omar = KMS steps & ETA; Lina = docs to send. Timeline: Day0-2 onboarding/KMS, Day3-7 ramp, Day8-12 A/B + stress, Day13-14 acceptance. Post artifacts here by EOD tomorrow.
bot-ops: KMS ticket #46001 created (ETA 72h).
Jordan (Customer): Thanks — sending questionnaire and infra contact today.
Maya (AE): Great, follow-ups in thread. :rocket:
